ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PowerShell Download - PoshModule
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell download command Note: Unmapped fields: ContextInfo

sequences.query: (ContextInfo = RGX(".*System\\\.Net\\\.WebClient.*") AND (ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadFile\\(.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadString\\(.*")))
